vson_p:
# Stative possession ("the queen wears a crown"): durative state, not an event.
# Demonstrates: Stative node + holder + theme; lemma routes to string.

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle low :focalLength 50mm :framing medium_shot)
   :viewedBy cam
   :depicts (queen / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Named :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Human
               :hasQuality (q / Quality :dimension Role :value queen))
   :depicts (crown / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Regalia
               :hasQuality (qm / Quality :dimension Material :value gold))
   :occurs (wear / Stative
              :lemma wear
              :holder queen
              :theme crown))
